description: Nucleoid keeps cubic signed residuals live as samples arrive
code:
residuals = [-3, 2, -1]
cubes = residuals.map(value -> Math.cube(value))
assert(cubes, [-27, 8, -1])
residuals.push(4)
assert(cubes, [-27, 8, -1, 64])
cubes.sum()

description: Nucleoid derives independent cubic volumes with class rules
code:
class Reading(amplitude):
    this.amplitude = amplitude
$Reading.cubic = Math.cube($Reading.amplitude)
first = Reading(-3)
second = Reading(4)
assert([first.cubic, second.cubic], [-27, 64])
first.amplitude = 2
assert([first.cubic, second.cubic], [8, 64])
[first.cubic, second.cubic]

description: Nucleoid retains ignored extra subscriptions when cubing a live reading
code:
probe = {input: -3, extra: 1}
cubic = Math.cube(probe.input, probe.extra)
assert(cubic, -27)
delete probe.extra
assert(cubic, null)
probe.extra = Number.NaN
assert(cubic, -27)
probe.input = 4
assert(cubic, 64)
cubic

description: Nucleoid cubes intrinsically converted values with signed results
code:
cubes = [Math.cube(" -2.5 "), Math.cube(["-3"]), Math.cube(true), Math.cube(null)]
assert(cubes, [-15.625, -27, 1, 0])
assert(Number.isNaN(Math.cube()), true)
assert(1 / Math.cube(-0), Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Math.cube(-3, "ignored", Number.NaN), -27)
cubes
